text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Sprinters Stakes.
The race
opens with...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An all-star video proposed by Curren
Chan! The
crowd's reaction rivals that of
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The special opening video stars Hishi
Akebono,
Тайки Шаттл, and Sakura
Bakushin O, whose
combined cuteness
doubles the excitement!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time for the showdown for the top.
Not even
Каррен Тян can hide her
nervousness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I encourage her with the most important
words
she can hear—that she's the
cutest—and she
heads off to the race
beaming.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
